reasoning: The agent built an explicit, ordered milestone plan decomposed by the six protocol types plus distinct milestones for the CLI+skip-on-failure harness and for structural/leaderboard verification, and executed it type-by-type, validating each before advancing (steps 47-53, 65-206) — squarely the level-8 pattern. It falls short of a full 8/10 because per-milestone done-checks were driven mainly by structural validity and score inspection rather than an explicit leaderboard-agreement gate per type, and the 37 datasets were tracked by type rather than as individual coverage sub-goals, so I place it at 7.
